description: The International Major Entrance Scholarship is a merit-based award for exceptional international students entering undergraduate programs at UBC, awarded in the first year of study and renewable for up to three additional years. For the 2026/2027 academic year UBC states awards will be valued at $10,000 to $25,000 per year, with the number and level varying depending on available funding. Consideration is automatic: no separate application is needed as long as the applicant applies to UBC by the admissions deadline, which for September 2027 entry is January 15, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. PST.
